verdict.rationale: Evidence pack only covers admin/founder-facing cap table management, fundraising, 409A valuations, and compliance tooling — none of it describes employee-facing plain-language guidance on tax treatment, exercise windows, or dilution. The 83(b) tracker (pulley-docs-13) is a status tool, not an explanatory feature. Missing for 10: employee-facing educational content, tax treatment explainers, exercise window guidance, dilution explanations in plain language.
